hypotheses.H_V: V (CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ADMISSION_TOOLS_CACHE=1) deletes >= 0.5 ms of T per task on R'n.
hypotheses.H_E2: With the best composed arm, the native text untested share of T falls below 5% on one source.
hypotheses.H_E3: S = median T(BASE) / median T(best composed) has a 95% CI above 1 on each task.

design.k1: 4x4 Williams square over BASE, X, X+V, X+V+HCL; 24 rounds per task (6 squares) = 24 pairs per contrast per task; both tasks per round (first task alternating by round); one fresh Driver and one fresh fixture per trial; blocks k1-r00..k1-r23 (one round each).
design.k5: 12 sessions per arm per task for X+V and X+V+HCL; 5 tasks per Driver session and fixture; AB/BA by session: per task, X+V first iff (round + fixed task index) is even (checkbox 0, text 1), so the order alternates across rounds for each task (6/6); blocks k5-r00..k5-r11.
design.s0_supplement: BASE vs S0, 24 rounds per task, AB/BA by round with the same fixed-index rule (12/12 per task); blocks s0-r00..s0-r23. Reported for S0 (KEEP-only); never used by a V/HCL gate.
design.order: k1 rounds, then k5 rounds, then s0 rounds, then the SHARED controls (smoke R'n, smoke R', V control, focus steal).

load_and_locks.load_rule: A measured round starts only at 1-minute loadavg <= 4.0 (read inside the lock, before the round). Otherwise /proc/loadavg is re-read every second for up to 60 s; if it never reaches <= 4.0 the chunk ends (exit 75), the locks are released, and the chunk resumes after 90 s. Every check is logged (raw load-gate.jsonl).
load_and_locks.measured_chunk: cargo-build lock first, then bin/quiet-timed <chunk> (EXCLUSIVE quiet-lane lock, receipt in the shared ledger), hard cap timeout 600 s inside; the harness starts no new round after 420 s. One private X session per chunk; the session is trusted only after a random 0-3 s wait and a passing xdpyinfo probe.
load_and_locks.controls: SHARED quiet-lane lock with receipt lines (lane ledger + shared ledger); load gate not applied.
load_and_locks.keep_every_trial: Every trial, every round attempt and every chunk log is kept. A round interrupted by the hard cap (no DONE) is kept and re-run under the next label suffix; its rows are reported and excluded from pairs only because its round is incomplete.

forced_path_and_route.every_action: receipt route 'accessibility'; the full R2-04 mark sequence in order (click: element_resolved, placement_done, reveal_done, ax_start, focus_guard captured, atspi_action connected/live_checked/metadata_done/do_action_replied/post_sleep_done, focus_guard body_done/restored, click ax_joined; set_value: element_resolved, cursor_done, write_done, readback_done).
forced_path_and_route.every_call: dispatch_enter/dispatch_exit marks; the N-02 MCP span marks request_read, parse_done, handler_start, handler_end, serialize_done, response_written in order; client stamps client_send, client_recv, validate_start, validate_end.
forced_path_and_route.V: V arms show mcp.inner_validation_skipped inside every in-T tools/call; non-V arms never show it and show mcp.inner_tools_list_built.
forced_path_and_route.HCL: HCL arms show a compile span inside the first call of each tool only (task 0) and none afterwards; non-HCL arms show none.
forced_path_and_route.knobs: exp_knob marks equal the arm's knobs ({post_action_sleep_ms=0} for X, X+V, X+V+HCL, S0; none for BASE and D); cursor glide_duration_ms 1.0 for X, X+V, X+V+HCL and 0.0 (default) for BASE and S0; cursor enabled.
forced_path_and_route.violation: any violation makes the row invalid (it stays in its cell's denominator).

oracle: The fixture's CUA_GTK3_TASK_STATE file (fresh path per trial, written by the app with atomic replace), read every 2 ms by a harness thread independent of the Driver. A task is verified iff the first sample at/after the last action's return shows the expected state and the final state has seq == before.seq + 1. T_oracle (R2-10 definition) = first observation send -> read-end of that sample. T_land = first observation send -> read-end of the first sample showing the expected state (at any time).

statistics.paired: within-round differences a - b, median with a seeded percentile bootstrap 95% CI over pairs (10000 resamples, seed 20261003); a pair with an invalid side is dropped from the pair statistic only.
statistics.S: S = median T(BASE) / median T(arm) over paired rounds; paired bootstrap over rounds (10000, seed 20261003) - the R2-10 ratio_stat rule.
statistics.best_composed: per task, the composed arm (X, X+V, X+V+HCL) with the lowest median T_oracle among arms whose cell validity is >= 95%; ties -> the earlier of X, X+V, X+V+HCL. Selected on the same data (disclosed: a min over three arms; S is also reported for every composed arm).

gates.V: DELETED iff the paired T saving (X - X+V, k=1) is >= 0.5 ms with a 95% CI excluding 0 on BOTH tasks. Otherwise KILL. The V control is reported next to it.
gates.HCL: per task: DELETED iff the k=1 saving (X+V - X+V+HCL) is >= 0.5 ms with a 95% CI excluding 0; otherwise OWNER_DECISION (session-shape dependent). Overall DELETED iff both tasks are DELETED. The k=5 per-session savings (sum of the 5 T's, X+V - X+V+HCL) are reported per session and as a paired median with CI.
gates.E3: S_best per task with CI; also S for every composed arm, S0 (KEEP-only, from the supplement) and T_land S. H_E3 holds on a task iff the S_best CI lower bound > 1.
gates.E2: decompose the best arm with N-03's sub-spans; primary reading = R2-10 taxonomy with the action transport split; conservative reading = also split the observation transport. Verdicts: settle IRREDUCIBLE (CL settle clamp KILL per OWN-20G); reveal residual OWNER_DECISION; post-action sleep DELETED (N-01R); driver serialize/write IRREDUCIBLE (N-02); client output validation OWNER_DECISION if HCL is OWNER_DECISION, residual UNTESTED if HCL is DELETED; V-targeted admission residual UNTESTED if V is DELETED, IRREDUCIBLE if V is KILL; other R2-10 labels as N-03 carried them; every other sub-span UNTESTED. Report the untested share per task in both readings; target < 5%.
gates.validity: >= 95% valid per cell (task x arm for k=1, k=5 and the supplement). Failures stay in the denominators.
gates.work_vs_wall: Report work deleted (component and sub-span means, BASE - best; admission and validation work per contrast) separately from wall-clock saved (paired median T).

controls.V_control: 5 X+V rows and 5 X reference rows (vctl): tools/list re-listed mid-session returns the identical inventory; an unknown tool is refused before and after the re-list with the same error as in X; known tools are admitted in the modern and legacy eras; the task verifies.
controls.HCL_offline: hc_control.py on the measured k=1 corpus (rounds 0 and 12, X+V+HCL): 10 injected invalid outputs per tool, each rejected by both the lazy and the library path, for every tool used (list_windows, set_agent_cursor_motion, get_agent_cursor_state, get_window_state, set_value, click); every real output accepted by both. N-03's mutation strategies unchanged (including its appended array-item strategies).
controls.HCL_online: every lazily validated call re-checked by the library path after the trial (outside T); verdicts must agree.
controls.default_off_smoke: R'n vs R' with no knobs and no trace file (arm D), 5 per task each: identical tools/list sha256, 5/5 verified per task on both, identical receipt shapes and routes, no non-empty trace file, no exp env.
controls.focus_steal: 20 rows on X+V+HCL (10 per task), focus stolen ~100 ms after the app's state change: reported, no gate. The deadline-exit gap in the focus guard is known (OWN-20G) and R'n does not carry OWN-20G's guard final diff G.

e4: Per arm, 0 of each: duplicate mutation (seq advanced by more than 1), success claimed by the receipt before the oracle, stale dispatch, blind replay, authority from passive state.
deviation_to_state: Native T excludes provider decisions (scripted chooser). This needs an owner ruling and is stated, not hidden.
claim_boundary: One host, private Xvfb + AT-SPI, GTK3 canonical fixture, binary R'n only, no provider. Never compared with R' 922111c5 timings or N-03 (N3) numbers. Knobs env-gated and default-off; no new service; events are never the oracle.
